items.title: DeepMind 运作模式曝光！暗示根本没输 OpenAI：员工20% 时间重启创新，保守巨头直接变 “实验狂”
items.raw_excerpt: 很多人知道，Transformer 是谷歌发明的。但 ChatGPT，却不是谷歌做出来的。这件事，在过去几年，几乎成了硅谷最大的“遗憾注脚”。

title_i18n.zh: DeepMind 运作模式曝光！暗示根本没输 OpenAI：员工20% 时间重启创新，保守巨头直接变 “实验狂”
title_i18n.en: DeepMind's operational model revealed! It suggests they never lost to OpenAI: employees spend 20% of their time reigniting innovation, transforming the conservative giant directly into an "experimentation enthusiast."
title_i18n.es: ¡Se revela el modelo operativo de DeepMind! Sugiere que en realidad no ha perdido ante OpenAI: los empleados dedican el 20% de su tiempo a reiniciar la innovación, transformando al gigante conservador en un "fanático de los experimentos".

excerpt_i18n.zh: 很多人知道，Transformer 是谷歌发明的。但 ChatGPT，却不是谷歌做出来的。这件事，在过去几年，几乎成了硅谷最大的“遗憾注脚”。
excerpt_i18n.en: Many people know that the Transformer was invented by Google. However, ChatGPT was not created by Google. This has become one of Silicon Valley's biggest "regrettable footnotes" in recent years.
excerpt_i18n.es: Mucha gente sabe que el Transformer fue inventado por Google. Pero ChatGPT no fue creado por Google. Esto, en los últimos años, se ha convertido casi en la mayor "nota a pie de página de lamento" de Silicon Valley.

items.title: Sowbot – open-hardware agricultural robot (ROS2, RTK GPS)
items.raw_excerpt:
Sowbot is an open-hardware agricultural robot designed to close the "prototype gap" that kills most agri-robotics startups and research projects — the 18+ months spent on drivers, networking, safety watchdogs, and UI before you can even start on the thing you actually care about. The hardware is built around a stackable 10×10cm compute module with two ARM Cortex-A55 SBCs — one for ROS 2 navigation/EKF localisation, one dedicated to vision/YOLO inference — connected via a single ethernet cable. Centimetre-level positioning via dual RTK GNSS, CAN bus for field comms, and real-time motor control via ESP32 running Lizard firmware. Everything — schematics, PCB layouts, firmware — is under open licences.
The software stack runs on RoSys/Field Friend (for teams who want fast iteration) or DevKit

The hardware is built around a stackable 10×10cm compute module with two ARM Cortex-A55 SBCs — one for ROS 2 navigation/EKF localisation, one dedicated to vision/YOLO inference — connected via a single ethernet cable. excerpt_i18n.zh: Sowbot是一款开源硬件农业机器人，旨在弥合导致多数农业机器人初创企业和研究项目失败的“原型鸿沟”——即耗费超过18个月时间在驱动程序、网络通信、安全监控及用户界面开发上的困境。

items.title: Agentic AI with multi-model framework using Hugging Face smolagents on AWS
items.raw_excerpt: Hugging Face smolagents is an open source Python library designed to make it straightforward to build and run agents using a few lines of code. We will show you how to build an agentic AI solution by integrating Hugging Face smolagents with Amazon Web Services (AWS) managed services. You'll learn how to deploy a healthcare AI agent that demonstrates multi-model deployment options, vector-enhanced knowledge retrieval, and clinical decision support capabilities.

You'll learn how to deploy a healthcare AI agent that demonstrates multi-model deployment options, vector-enhanced knowledge retrieval, and clinical decision support capabilities.
